reason: The monoclinic cell and Z=4 are well supported by indexing, and the submitted P2_1/c models are compositionally valid with broadly plausible coordination, but exact structure recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the trajectory instead optimized a custom fixed-profile normalized SSE of about 0.042-0.045 (roughly a 20% relative residual on a square-root scale) while fitting many positional parameters with an empirical chemical penalty. It did not perform or report a standard whole-pattern refinement with uncertainties, and it did not materially compare lower-symmetry or alternative framework models. P2_1/c is inferred mainly from absences and a related VOF3 prototype, which supports the average framework more than the exact symmetry and coordinates. Cu Kalpha diffraction provides little O/F contrast: several O/F permutations had similar raw profile scores, only a subset was jointly optimized, and the two submitted orderings do not resolve or exhaust that discrete ambiguity. Li is especially weakly constrained by X-rays and was selected through the same penalized objective. Thus the cell, Z, and a plausible average framework may be correct, but the submitted symmetry, coordinates, Li position, and O/F/V charge ordering remain underdetermined; another scientifically motivated attempt using a conventional whole-pattern refinement and broader symmetry/framework/ordering comparison could materially improve the candidate set.
